scores.evidence: PHASE 1: Setup & Authentication ... PHASE 2: Core Infrastructure ... PHASE 3: Intelligence ... PHASE 4: Automation
scores.rationale: Phases roughly go substrate to upward, but nothing is gated on proof, and guardrails and auth come without ordering logic.
Phase 1 is setup only; no thin end-to-end production slice exists before features.

scores.evidence: LLM Integration | Claude API / OpenAI GPT-4
scores.rationale: Choices are left as 'X or Y' with no default, flip condition or irreversible-decision list.
Items within phases are listed without any blast-radius ordering.

scores.evidence: Never auto-close without high confidence (>0.95) ... Maintain audit log of all agent decisions
scores.rationale: Safety measures sit in a standalone section, not in the phases, and prompt injection and credential scoping get no real treatment.
Monitoring appears only in Phase 2 and in a metrics table, not from a Phase 0 and not in every phase.
Nothing on pinned environments, reproducible builds, or versioned data, prompts or models.

scores.evidence: Polling Fallback: Periodic checks for new/updated issues
scores.rationale: Failure handling is limited to a polling fallback, rate limits and an undo mechanism, and none of it is tied to phases.

scores.evidence: Start with read-only actions before automation
scores.rationale: Guardrails and human escalation exist and read-only start is mentioned, but it is a late note, and the phases put intelligence before guardrails, budgets and HITL, with no cost budgets.
There is no explicit deferred-work list and no pull-forward conditions.

note: Generic feature-oriented plan with a sensible component list and standalone safety section, but it has no walking skeleton, no decision gates, no reproducibility, and no deferral logic.
